advisory.symptoms: Vibrant emerald green foliage with smooth lamina, unobstructed venation, and balanced chlorophyll synthesis. No fungal lesions or bacterial blight detected.
advisory.immediate_action: Continue routine crop monitoring. Inspect leaf undersides twice weekly for early sucking pests (aphids, jassids, thrips, whiteflies).
advisory.organic_remedy: Preventative spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Panchagavya (3%) to enhance systemic plant immunity and deter vector pests.
advisory.chemical_control: No fungicide or bactericide application required. For balanced vegetative vigor, apply foliar 19:19:19 (NPK) @ 5 g/L or 1% Potassium Nitrate (13-0-45) during square formation.
advisory.preventive_measures: Maintain scheduled drip irrigation without waterlogging. Keep yellow and blue sticky traps (10 per acre) across the field border.
advisory.voice_summary: Great news! Your cotton leaf is completely healthy. Continue regular field scouting and maintain balanced nutrition.

advisory.pathogen: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum (Soil-borne Fungus)
advisory.symptoms: Leaves lose turgidity, turn dull yellow from bottom upwards, margins curl and dry. Vascular browning/blackening visible when stem or taproot is sliced longitudinally.
advisory.immediate_action: Immediately uproot and burn wilted plants together with their root balls. Drench soil in a 2-meter radius to halt underground fungal mycelium spread.
advisory.organic_remedy: Enrich 500 kg well-decomposed Farmyard Manure (FYM) with 5 kg Trichoderma viride or Trichoderma harzianum; broadcast at root zones. Apply Neem cake @ 250 kg/acre.
advisory.chemical_control: Soil drenching around root base with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1.5–2.0 g/L OR Benomyl 50% WP @ 1.0 g/L (apply 200–300 ml drenching solution per plant). Spray Potassium Nitrate (13-0-45) @ 10 g/L to reduce vascular stress.
advisory.preventive_measures: Implement 3-year crop rotation with non-host cereals (maize, sorghum). Practice deep summer ploughing for solarizing resting chlamydospores. Cultivate wilt-resistant hybrids.
advisory.voice_summary: Fusarium Wilt detected. Uproot heavily wilted plants and drench surrounding soil with Carbendazim at 2 grams per liter or Trichoderma enriched manure.

advisory.symptoms: Classic interveinal chlorosis and necrosis creating a mottled 'tiger-stripe' pattern on leaves. Plants exhibit stunted growth, shedding of squares/bolls, and olive-brown vascular rings.
advisory.immediate_action: Rogue out early symptomatic plants. Avoid high-volume flood irrigation down rows as water streams transport infectious microsclerotia.
advisory.organic_remedy: Apply Paecilomyces lilacinus or Trichoderma viride enriched compost into the rhizosphere. Implement mustard/radish green manure bio-fumigation before sowing.
advisory.chemical_control: Soil drenching around root zone with Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP @ 1.5 g/L OR Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP (Saaf) @ 2.0 g/L. Foliar spray of micro-nutrients (Zinc + Boron + Magnesium) to restore vitality.
advisory.preventive_measures: Crop rotation with paddy rice (paddy submersion destroys microsclerotia) or sorghum. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer; balance with potassium and phosphorus.
advisory.voice_summary: Verticillium Wilt detected with tiger-stripe leaf patterns. Drench root zones with Thiophanate Methyl 1.5 grams per liter. Avoid over-irrigation.

advisory.symptoms: Circular to irregular brown spots with concentric target-board rings. Spots coalesce causing extensive leaf blight, drying, and early defoliation.
advisory.immediate_action: Isolate affected zones. Prune and destroy heavily blighted lower foliage. Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation during evening hours.
advisory.organic_remedy: Foliar spray of cold-pressed Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or 10,000 ppm Azadirachtin (2 ml/L). Apply bio-agent Pseudomonas fluorescens (2.5 kg/ha) or Trichoderma viride (10 g/L) to leaf surfaces.
advisory.chemical_control: Foliar spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0–2.5 g/L (500–600 g/acre) OR Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 ml/L OR Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1.0 ml/L. Repeat at 12–14 day intervals.
advisory.preventive_measures: Ensure balanced Potassium (K2O) fertilization (potassium deficiency drastically increases Alternaria susceptibility). Maintain 90x60 cm plant spacing to improve canopy ventilation.
advisory.voice_summary: Alternaria Leaf Spot detected. Spray Mancozeb at 2.5 grams per liter or Neem oil at 3 ml per liter. Ensure adequate potassium fertilizer.

advisory.symptoms: Angular, water-soaked translucent lesions delimited by leaf veins. Lesions turn reddish-brown to black. Can advance to 'black arm' on stems and water-soaked boll rot.
advisory.immediate_action: Suspend nitrogen top-dressing immediately (excess nitrogen promotes vulnerable succulent growth). Avoid field operations when foliage is wet.
advisory.organic_remedy: Spray fresh Cow Urine (5%) blended with a pinch of Asafoetida (Hing) or Bio-agent Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L. Spray certified organic Copper Hydroxide.
advisory.chemical_control: Foliar spray of Streptocycline (Streptomycin sulphate 90% + Tetracycline hydrochloride 10%) @ 100 mg/L (1 g in 10 L water) TANK-MIXED with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5–3.0 g/L. Repeat in 10–12 days.
advisory.preventive_measures: Sow acid-delinted and certified disease-free seed. Treat seed with Carboxin + Thiram before planting. Burn crop residues post-harvest.
advisory.voice_summary: Bacterial Blight detected. Spray Streptocycline 1 gram in 10 liters of water mixed with Copper Oxychloride 25 grams. Stop applying excess nitrogen.
